premises.text: Camera software projects routinely fail under local network complexity, device fragmentation, and laborious per-customer deployment
premises.evidence_span: this project was bigger than they had anticipated, was risky and expensive

premises.text: EverCam exposes a hosted modern web API that removes that complexity from software developers
premises.evidence_span: expose to the software developer a beautiful, modern, hosted web API

premises.text: The platform helps camera owners connect and stay connected, guarantees API software works with any internet-connected camera, and distributes camera apps like a phone app store
premises.evidence_span: We guarantee when software is written for our API that it will work with any camera that can be connected to the internet

premises.text: The product is an entirely developer-focused hosted API, superior to security products that merely add an API and to local development platforms
premises.evidence_span: our product is an API. It's entirely developer-focused

premises.text: EverCam earns a recurring fee on a per-camera basis when customers deploy solutions
premises.evidence_span: EverCam is generating a recurring fee on a per-camera basis

value.text: Make cameras programmable so developers can build live-image applications that improve customer businesses
value.evidence_span: make these cameras programmable, and thereby to unleash a whole new category of software development based around the live image

causal_links.evidence_span: they could provide a much better service if they could access the cameras
EverCam is generating a recurring fee on a per-camera basis

notes: Three named platform capabilities folded into P3 as one offering (§4.1(5)/(2)). Android/iOS analogy treated as vision framing (§4.1(4)). Singleton D1 and D3 justified: problem diagnosis and pricing are separately revisable from the API stack. Team bio excluded.
